name: Stratego® Online
description:
About This Game

The beloved strategy game Stratego, known for its tactical depth and captivating gameplay, is now available to a global audience through a modern and engaging online platform!

Stratego Online brings the timeless strategy and excitement of the original board game to your phone.

Stratego is a two-player strategy game where each player controls an army of 40 pieces with the goal of capturing the enemy flag. The pieces of the opponent are hidden until engaged in battle, so you’ll have to be tactical to reveal the location of important enemy pieces.

Use special pieces, like bombs, miners and spies to gain an advantage over your opponent and win.

ONLINE RANKED MATCHMAKING

Play competitive Stratego battles against players from all over the world! Climb the ranked ladder from recruit up to grandmaster and fight for a spot on the leaderboard.

CHALLENGE BOT OPPONENTS

Try your skills against one of the three bot opponents in a thrilling single-player match. Each bot brings a new difficulty level for you to overcome!

SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN

Experience a new way to play the board game in a story mode about a traitor that has infiltrated the bluecoat army. Play through 15 different gameplay scenarios with story, unique objectives, and new gameplay mechanics that can be recognized from other versions of Stratego throughout the years.

PREPARE YOUR STRATEGY

Stratego Online allows you to prepare your piece arrangement before you jump in a game, greatly reducing the setup time that is normally needed before starting to play. You can also rewatch your games to study your mistakes, adapt your strategies, and beat your rivals.

CROSS-PLATFORM & SOCIAL

You can connect and play with players playing on all our supported platforms. Add players as friends to chat with them, spectate their games and challenge them for friendly battles.

CONTINUOUS DEVELOPMENT

We’re constantly updating the game to release new exciting features. Join our Discord server so even your suggestions might be included in the next update!
short_desc: Stratego Online brings the timeless strategy and excitement of the original board game into the 21st century, providing players with an immersive online experience that blends classic gameplay with innovative features.
